title: 第25章 巨龙奥罗拉第26章 狼狈而逃的卡拉波斯
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
城堡之中，施展魔法打开了地狱，获得无穷地狱之力加持的女巫卡拉波斯实力暴涨，周身萦绕着的暗绿色地狱之火熊熊燃烧起来。
庞大无比的魔力疯狂涌动，让她的身形直接悬浮于半空，然后居高临下俯视着下方的李凯南。
“骑士，我再给你最后一次机会。献上亚当王子的人头，再跪下向我求饶……”
李凯南懒得听她扯淡，周身的恐怖力量汇聚爆发，直朝卡拉波斯的方向高高跃去。
几乎是一瞬间，李凯南快到肉眼无法捕捉的身形便已经出现在了半空中。
手中那柄闪烁着纯白光辉，带着圣洁破邪之力的骑士剑重重挥下。
此时的卡拉波斯明明已经得到了地狱之力的加持，所拥有的力量比刚刚强大不止数倍。
可面对着李凯南这至高圣洁、能够祛除一切邪恶的“破邪之力”，她所使用的地狱魔法便是天然被克制！
卡拉波斯那强大又邪恶的地狱魔力充斥在四周，本应该被她任意调动用来攻击李凯南才对。
可面对那纯白圣洁的剑光笼罩，这些邪恶魔力便立刻如同太阳出来后的晨间薄雾一般飞快消散。
而卡拉波斯身体四周萦绕着的幽绿色地狱之火，本来是保护她这个“脆皮法师”不害怕有强大骑士突然近身的最大底气。
她强行打开了地狱通道，得到了地狱之力的加持，周身地狱之火更加凶烈恐怖。
卡拉波斯本以为这样强大的地狱之火，足以抵抗李凯南身上那股圣洁之力。
可是在直面李凯南这一剑的时候，被加强过的地狱之火依旧显得不堪一击，直接化作点点绿色火光崩散四溅！
卡拉波斯后撤不及，腹部前鲜血飞溅。
这一剑，直接在她腹部处劈开了一道极为恐怖的伤口，甚至几乎可以视作被当场腰斩！
李凯南身形落地，抬头看向上方的卡拉波斯，不由眉头一动。
这都没死？
作为掌握了地狱之力的女巫、当世数一数二的至强者，卡拉波斯某种意义上来说就是超越了死亡的存在！
差点被腰斩这种对于普通人来说就足以致命的恐怖伤势，对她而言显然不是那么要命。

但关键问题却是李凯南所拥有的“破邪之力”，对于掌握破邪之力的她来说就是天然克星！
她伤口之上残存的“破邪之力”，此时就好似带着腐蚀性一般，发出了“滋滋滋”的声响不断祛除着她的邪恶地狱力量。
那几乎被一剑腰斩的恐怖伤势，卡拉波斯并没有多么难受。
可“破邪之力”不断侵蚀、祛除她体内地狱之力的时候，却给她带来钻心蚀骨的强烈痛苦，让卡拉波斯发出了无法忍受的痛苦哀嚎：
“啊啊啊啊啊！”
也是直到这个时候，卡拉波斯才清楚地意识到自己根本无法对付李凯南。
如果只是单纯的肉体强横也就罢了，可偏偏李凯南拥有着“破邪之力”特质。
如果换做其他超凡者过来对付李凯南，都不至于表现得如此被动、如此毫无还手之力。
但卡拉波斯的力量来自于地狱，使用的都是地狱魔法。
地狱之力固然强大，让卡拉波斯成功祸乱了大陆之上最为强盛、供奉了十二位仙女的卡佩王国。
content_en:
In the castle, magic was used to open the hell. The witch Carabosse, blessed by the infinite power of hell, was so powerful that the dark green hellfire lingering around her burned fiercely.
The huge amount of magic surged crazily, causing her figure to float directly in the air, and then she looked down at Li Kainan below.
"Knight, I will give you one last chance. Offer the head of Prince Adam, and then kneel down and beg me for mercy..."
Li Kainan was too lazy to listen to her nonsense. The terrifying power around him gathered and exploded, and he jumped high in the direction of Carabosse.
Almost instantly, Li Kainan's figure, which was too fast to be caught by the naked eye, appeared in mid-air.
The knight's sword in his hand was shining with pure white light and had the power to destroy evil, and he swung it down heavily.
At this time, Carabosse has clearly been blessed by the power of hell, and his power is several times stronger than before.
But facing Li Kainan, the supreme and holy "evil-destroying power" that can eliminate all evil, the hell magic she used was naturally restrained!
Carabosse's powerful and evil hellish magic was everywhere, and she should have mobilized it at will to attack Li Kainan.
But facing the pure white and holy sword light, these evil magic powers immediately dissipated like the morning mist after the sun came out.
The green hellfire lingering around Carabosse's body was originally the best way to protect her, a "squishy mage," from fear of a powerful knight suddenly approaching.
She forcibly opened the passage to hell and was blessed by the power of hell, making the hell fire around her even more fierce and terrifying.
Carabosse thought that such powerful hellfire would be enough to resist the holy power of Li Kainan.
But when facing Li Kainan's sword, the strengthened hellfire still seemed vulnerable, and it directly turned into dots of green fire and scattered in all directions!
Carabosse couldn't retreat in time, and blood splattered in front of his abdomen.
This sword opened an extremely terrifying wound directly on her abdomen, which could almost be regarded as being cut in half on the spot!
Li Kainan landed on the ground, looked up at Carabosse above, and couldn't help but frown.
Not even dead?
As a witch who has mastered the power of hell and one of the strongest people in the world, Carabosse is an existence that transcends death in a sense!
Being almost cut in half, a terrifying injury that would be fatal to ordinary people, was obviously not that fatal to her.
But the key issue is the "evil-destroying power" possessed by Li Kainan. For her who has mastered the evil-destroying power, she is a natural nemesis!
The remaining "evil-destroying power" on her wound seemed to be corrosive at this time, making a "sizzling" sound and constantly destroying her evil hellish power.
Carabosse didn't feel too uncomfortable about the horrific injury that nearly cut him in half with a sword.
But when the "Evil-Breaking Power" continued to erode and eliminate the power of hell in her body, it brought her heart-breaking and bone-crushing pain, causing Carabosse to cry out in unbearable pain:
"Ahhhhhh!"
It was only at this time that Carabosse clearly realized that he could not deal with Li Kainan at all.
If it's just physical violence, that's it, but Li Kainan has the trait of "power to destroy evil".
If it were other extraordinary beings who came to deal with Li Kainan, they wouldn't be so passive and helpless to fight back.
But Carabosse's power comes from hell, and he uses hell magic.
The power of hell is indeed powerful, allowing Carabosse to successfully disrupt the Cape Kingdom, the most powerful kingdom on the continent that worships twelve fairies.
